page.layout: One page of text in two blocks: a wide column of Latin notes at top, then a main column with Hebrew lines and Latin text below; notes in the left and right margins are none beyond the top notes block.

main_text.p: 8.9. (10) Senfus eft, Minorennem qui semel pro patre pecunias attulit, semper deinde illas singulis annis iterum afferre debere & posse, donec maior natu pro se ipso siclum solvat. Vid. Maym. Schekal. cap.1. (11) פני דרך שלום significat aliquando pacis & concordiae causâ, aliquando honoris & civilitatis causâ, ut hic indecorum enim fuisset tam rigide cum venerandis illis Viris agere; Notat tamen Maymon l. m. c. quamvis pignora à Sacerdotibus non sumserint, ipsos tamen non cessasse ab ipsis petere donec solvissent. (12) De titulo Rabbi vid.pag 498. (13) Quis fuerit Rabbi Ichuda vid.pag.255. (14) Quis Ben Bucri fuerit videre poteris ex Iuchasin. (15) De urbe Iafne vid. p.250. (16) De Rabban Iochanan Ben Saccai vid. p.284. (17) Occurrit obiectioni, quam Sacerdotes pro sua exemptione ex Lev. vi. facere possent; se scil. nihil debere, quia oblatio ipsorum debeat manere integra: cum tamen pecunia siclorum ad varios usus adhibeatur. (18) De עומר vid. p.572. & 485. (19) De panibus propositionis vid.pag. 437. & 572. (21) Omnia tamen cedebant Sacerdotibus, vid. pag.576.
main_text.head: V. Etiamsi autem dicant, mulieres servos & parvulos non oppignorari, si tamen [siclum] dare volunt, ab ipsis accipiunt.
main_text.p: Si autem (1) Idololatra aliquis aut (2) Cuthaeus [siclum]

page.notes: Hebrew lines in the centre block are printed in Hebrew characters (partly Hebrew pointed text) and are transcribed only in outline; the Hebrew block reads: ה אף על פי / שאמרו אין ממשכנין / נשים ועבדים וקטני / אם שקלו מקבלין / מידן העכו"ם והכותי / ששקלו אין מקבלין מידן / קיני זבים וקיני זבורת. Hebrew words are uncertain in places and marked as such by the surrounding text. Remaining top-notes numerals and sigla are as printed; the page is lightly damaged at the right edge.
